d:
Ex-Muslim YouTuber and activist Sahil has claimed that he was attacked by a group of around 12 people in Mumbai's Vashi area on Saturday night.
According to Sahil, the attackers were allegedly angry with his views on Islam and tried to kill him.
In a viral livestream, he showed injuries on his face and hand and claimed that he narrowly escaped the attack.
The incident has drawn attention to the safety of people who leave their religion and openly express their views.
